description:
Move the real LPBS desktop release flow into deployment-manager so the operator can drive end-to-end desktop release from the canonical deployment control plane.

The finished state should preserve prompt-manager skills as automation clients and helpers, but deployment-manager should become the authoritative surface for release gating, release execution, LPBS publication, and operator-visible status.
name: deployment-manager-lpbs-desktop-release-orchestration
title: Make Deployment Manager Own LPBS Desktop Release Orchestration
